name: 7-Eleven Grocery DC Fort Worth TX (McLane North Texas)

fieldNotes.facility: McLane North Texas grocery DC, 7550 Oak Grove Rd, in Carter Industrial Park. McLane built out ~625k sq ft of a vacant ~1.2M sq ft ex-Associated Wholesale Grocers building on a 90.7-acre parcel (opened March 2019). Ambient + cooler + freezer; serves 7-Eleven and other c-stores across DFW, OK, KS, AR, LA.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled property: black metal perimeter fence confirmed along the SE/E (south-road Street View) and a masonry/precast perimeter wall on the W between McLane and the 7401 office property. Single shared vehicle/truck entrance off the N-S west road (Oak Grove Rd frontage) at ~32.6409,-97.3116 feeding the employee lot and the paved yard. No barrier arm visible at the throat in 2022-2025 imagery.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone guard booth visible at the entrance in any satellite (z20) or Street View frame. The only small entrance-area structures are the office/breakroom modules at the SW and an in-yard trailer-maintenance shop + fuel island; none is a gate guard shack. Set guardShack=false, remoteGs=true (gated/fenced site, kiosk/app check-in implied). Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Vast paved yard inside the entrance with marked trailer stalls and open apron provides deep internal staging/queuing before the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Entrance opens into a very deep paved drive/yard; easily holds 3+ trucks queued before docks.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: One shared entrance/exit point on the west road; no separate out-gate observed.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Wide paved entrance throat; estimated ~2 inbound, 1 outbound. Low confidence (no painted lane markings at the throat).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Large open paved apron at the entrance and inside the yard — ample unused width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long continuous dock run on the building's E face (trailers backed in across ~40+ doors) plus dock canopies on the SW/S face. Total well into 50+ band; dockDoorCount~110 is an overhead estimate (low confidence on exact count).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated paved trailer drop yard E of the building with many marked stalls; 80-120 trailers/containers parked in captured imagery -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock clusters on different building faces (long E-face dock bank serving the trailer yard, plus S/SW-face dock canopies) suggest physically separate ship/receive areas. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale/weigh pad identified in the truck path.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs N-S just E of the building, but no spur enters the McLane building (docks served by trailers, not rail cars). railServed=false.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main DC building (incl. attached cooler/freezer plant + SW office) counted as one large structure; plus the in-yard trailer-maintenance shop and the fuel-island canopy = 3 distinct structures.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter polygon (operational paved property: building + drop yard + office) ~64 acres. The full ex-AWG parcel is 90.7 acres including the undeveloped grass field to the E, which is excluded from the operational geofence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside Fort Worth / DFW metro dense industrial fabric (Carter Industrial Park) -> Urban; cellular coverage strong -> connectivityIssue=false.
fieldNotes.streetView: Only the entrance/employee-lot area has Street View coverage (Google car drove in, 2022-11 pano 3_3mZI03-fGvItei_Z28jA). Interior drop-yard and dock-apron centroids return ZERO_RESULTS, so those zones have no pano.
